fields.avg_price_gbp: average sale price, GBP, not FX-converted here
fields.flat_gbp: average flat/maisonette price, GBP — the closest match to our apartment metric

meta.currency_caveat: Prices are GBP as published. Converting a 1970s-2020s price series with a single pinned 2026 FX rate would be misleading, so conversion is left to the UI, which labels it, and the historical chart is shown in GBP.
